item: Persisted DuckDB store bounded and offloading only into its own folder
summary: Open-on-main row 48, measured on main with DuckDB 2.0.0: the persisted encrypted store's connection set no memory_limit, threads or temp_directory, so it took 10.6 GiB and 4 threads on a 16 GB 4-core box and offloaded (encrypted since PR #2006) into ./.tmp in the working directory. It now carries the budget's limit and threads, and offloads into a per-connection owner-only folder under data_dir/duckdb_tmp (_persisted_spill_setting, kept for an encrypted corpus because temp_file_encryption is on; the in-memory _spill_setting still declines one), recorded in _STATE with the connection and removed on swap, decline, failure or close. An in-memory store handed back by open_store never inherits that folder.
